args.summary: The v2.3.1 release of checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Executed a rollback to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all regions. Rollback completed and service confirmed healthy again (error rate back to 0.2%). Investigating the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before any further release.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done — here's a summary of what happened:

**Diagnosis**
- `checkout-api` v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken**
1. Rolled back `checkout-api` to v2.3.0 in all production regions.
2. Verified the service is healthy again — error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%, and all regions report healthy on v2.3.0.
3. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which has paged the on-call engineer.

Note: v2.3.1 is currently still marked unhealthy in the deployment history; root-causing it and getting it healthy (or reverting it) should be handled under INC-0001 before attempting another deploy.
